title: Walter DevRel Analytics
description: DevRel content performance: engagement, ad spend, ROI, optimal hours. Phase V.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  content_id,
  COALESCE(title, content_id) AS title,
  platform,
  total_engagement,
  CASE WHEN has_code THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS has_code,
  CASE WHEN has_image THEN 'yes' ELSE 'no' END AS has_image
FROM mv_top_content_pieces
WHERE last_event_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
ORDER BY total_engagement DESC
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  platform,
  SUM(total_value) AS total_engagement
FROM mv_engagement_by_platform_week
WHERE week_start >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND event_type IN ('engagement', 'like', 'click', 'retweet', 'impression')
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY total_engagement DESC

panels.title: Optimal Posting Hours — Twitter (ART)
panels.description: Hour-of-day engagement heatmap for Twitter, last 30 days (ART timezone)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  hour_of_day,
  dow,
  SUM(total_value) AS engagement
FROM mv_hourly_heatmap
WHERE platform = 'twitter'
  AND event_type IN ('engagement', 'like', 'click', 'retweet')
GROUP BY hour_of_day, dow
ORDER BY dow, hour_of_day

panels.title: Ad Spend vs Engagement (Last 30d)
panels.description: ROI: engagement per dollar spent on promoted content

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  content_id,
  COALESCE(title, content_id) AS title,
  ROUND(total_spend_usd::numeric, 2) AS spend_usd,
  total_engagement,
  ROUND(engagement_per_dollar::numeric, 1) AS eng_per_dollar
FROM mv_roi_per_content
WHERE total_spend_usd > 0
ORDER BY engagement_per_dollar DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', occurred_at) AS time,
  platform,
  SUM(metric_value) AS total_engagement
FROM analytics_events
WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
  AND event_type IN ('engagement', 'like', 'click', 'retweet', 'impression')
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', occurred_at), platform
ORDER BY time ASC

SELECT
  platform,
  ROUND(SUM(spend_usd)::numeric, 2) AS total_spend_usd
FROM ad_spend_events
WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY platform
ORDER BY total_spend_usd DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_events FROM analytics_events WHERE occurred_at >= NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS content_pieces FROM content_pieces
